title: Norwegian Churches (kirker i Norge)
description: Comprehensive directory of Norwegian Christian churches across all 15 fylker (counties), multiple architectural styles, era subcategories, and denominations (Lutheran, Catholic, Den norske kirke). Includes Wikipedia titles, Wikidata QIDs, multilingual names (35 languages) and descriptions (7 languages), geographic coordinates, inception/consecration dates, Wikimedia Commons imagery, official websites, architectural style/material/heritage references, diocese, and Riksantikvaren heritage register IDs.

meta.title: Norwegian Churches (kirker i Norge) - Gratis nedlasting
meta.description: Comprehensive directory of Norwegian Christian churches across all 15 fylker (counties), multiple architectural styles, era subcategories, and denominations (Lutheran, Catholic, Den norske kirke). Includes Wikipedia titles, Wikidata QIDs, multilingual names (35 languages) and descriptions (7 languages), geographic coordinates, inception/consecration dates, Wikimedia Commons imagery, official websites, architectural style/material/heritage references, diocese, and Riksantikvaren heritage register IDs. Inneholder 2415 poster. Last ned i Excel, CSV, PDF format.
